mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalProcesses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN INSTANCE_STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runningProcesses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN INSTANCE_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedProcesses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN INSTANCE_STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejectedProcesses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN INSTANCE_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelledProcesses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN INSTANCE_STATUS = 'TERMINATED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS terminatedProcesses, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN INSTANCE_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, START_DATE, END_DATE) END)), 0) AS averageCompletedMinutes FROM fm_process_instance WHERE TENANT_ID = #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND START_DATE >= #{startDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND START_DATE < #{endDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}

SELECT reportDate, SUM(startedProcesses) AS startedProcesses, SUM(completedProcesses) AS completedProcesses, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(completedMinutes) / NULLIF(SUM(completedDurationCount), 0)), 0) AS averageCompletedMinutes FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reportDate, 1 AS startedProcesses, 0 AS completedProcesses, 0 AS completedMinutes, 0 AS completedDurationCount FROM fm_process_instance WHERE TENANT_ID = #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND START_DATE >= #{startDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND START_DATE < #{endDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reportDate, 0 AS startedProcesses, 1 AS completedProcesses, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, START_DATE, END_DATE) AS completedMinutes, 1 AS completedDurationCount FROM fm_process_instance WHERE TENANT_ID = #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND INSTANCE_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND END_DATE >= #{startDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND END_DATE < #{endDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ) daily GROUP BY reportDate ORDER BY reportDate

SELECT pi.PROCESS_DEF_ID AS processDefId, pd.PROCESS_NAME AS processName, COUNT(*) AS startedProcesses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pi.INSTANCE_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedProcesses, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pi.INSTANCE_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pi.START_DATE, pi.END_DATE) END)), 0) AS averageCompletedMinutes FROM fm_process_instance pi JOIN fm_process_def pd ON pd.TENANT_ID = pi.TENANT_ID AND pd.PROCESS_DEF_ID = pi.PROCESS_DEF_ID WHERE pi.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND pi.START_DATE >= #{startDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND pi.START_DATE < #{endDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} GROUP BY pi.PROCESS_DEF_ID, pd.PROCESS_NAME ORDER BY startedProcesses DESC, pd.PROCESS_NAME LIMIT 20

SELECT pi.PROCESS_DEF_ID AS processDefId, pd.PROCESS_NAME AS processName, action.TASK_DEF_KEY AS taskDefKey, COALESCE(tp.TASK_NAME, action.TASK_DEF_KEY) AS taskName, COUNT(*) AS completedTasks, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, assigned.assignedDate, action.ACTION_DATE))) AS averageHandlingMinutes, MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, assigned.assignedDate, action.ACTION_DATE)) AS maximumHandlingMinutes FROM fm_task_action action JOIN ( SELECT TENANT_ID, TASK_ID, MIN(RESOLVED_DATE) AS assignedDate FROM fm_task_assignment_snapshot WHERE TENANT_ID = #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TASK_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TENANT_ID, TASK_ID ) assigned ON assigned.TENANT_ID = action.TENANT_ID AND assigned.TASK_ID = action.TASK_ID JOIN fm_process_instance pi ON pi.TENANT_ID = action.TENANT_ID AND pi.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID = action.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID JOIN fm_process_def pd ON pd.TENANT_ID = pi.TENANT_ID AND pd.PROCESS_DEF_ID = pi.PROCESS_DEF_ID LEFT JOIN fm_task_policy tp ON tp.TENANT_ID = pi.TENANT_ID AND tp.PROCESS_DEF_ID = pi.PROCESS_DEF_ID AND tp.PROCESS_VERSION_NO = pi.PROCESS_VERSION_NO AND tp.TASK_DEF_KEY = action.TASK_DEF_KEY WHERE action.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND action.ACTION_DATE >= #{startDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND action.ACTION_DATE < #{endDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND action.ACTION_TYPE IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT', 'RETURN', 'RESUBMIT') AND action.ACTION_DATE >= assigned.assignedDate GROUP BY pi.PROCESS_DEF_ID, pd.PROCESS_NAME, action.TASK_DEF_KEY, COALESCE(tp.TASK_NAME, action.TASK_DEF_KEY) ORDER BY averageHandlingMinutes DESC, completedTasks DESC LIMIT 20
